item.title: Judge allows use of police interview in Tupac Shakur murder trial
item.description: A Nevada judge ruled on Tuesday that the recording of an interview the man accused in the killing Tupac Shakur gave to police in 2008 could be used at his upcoming trial.

item.title: Trump, Thune and many others remember late Sen. Lindsey Graham
item.description: Funeral services for Lindsey Graham took place across Washington today. Family, friends and colleagues gathered to honor the South Carolina Republican's legacy.

item.title: As many are priced out of buying, the renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever
item.description: Record high housing costs have pushed the wealth gap between renters and owners wider than ever. It's been a boon for owners even as many others are priced out.

item.title: 'Ricochet' explores how the right to bear arms expands -- while gun laws contract
item.description: The New York Times reporter Mike McIntire says gun companies and the NRA are broadening the scope of the Second Amendment, socializing kids to appreciate guns and marketing a new brand of masculinity.
